title: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Integration Plan
description: A structured plan for an OAuth/OIDC client integration so scripts/oauth2_and_oidc_from_scratch_audit.mjs can check it deterministically against OAuth 2.1 and the browser-based-apps BCP.

clientType.description: What kind of OAuth client this is.

flow.description: The grant type the plan intends to use. implicit and ropc are removed in OAuth 2.1 and always fail the audit.

oidc.description: True if OpenID Connect is in play (an ID token is requested and used for identity).

usesPkce.description: True if code_challenge/code_verifier (S256) are sent on every authorization request.

browserArchitecture.description: How the browser side is architected; 'none' for non-browser clients.

tokenStorage.description: Where access/refresh tokens live from the browser's point of view.

statePresent.description: True if a random state parameter is generated per login, stored session-bound, and checked on the callback (CSRF defense).

noncePresent.description: True if a random nonce is sent and the ID token's nonce claim is compared to it (replay defense).

redirectUriMatching.description: How the registered redirect_uri is matched; anything but 'exact' fails.

idTokenValidation.description: How the ID token is validated (required in practice when oidc is true).

library.description: 'vetted' = jose / authlib / go-jose / nimbus-jose-jwt class of library.

algPinned.description: True if the expected signing algorithm is pinned in the verifier.

checksIssuer.description: True if iss is compared exactly to the configured issuer.

checksAudience.description: True if aud is checked to contain the client_id.

checksNonce.description: True if the nonce claim is compared to the sent value.

refreshTokens.description: Refresh-token policy, if refresh tokens are issued.

issued.description: True if the integration receives refresh tokens.

rotationEnabled.description: True if each exchange issues a new refresh token and invalidates the old one.

storage.description: Where refresh tokens live; 'browser' always fails.

jwksSource.description: Where IdP signing keys come from; must be the /.well-known/jwks.json endpoint with a TTL cache.

clockSkewSeconds.description: Clock-skew tolerance applied to exp/iat/nbf; must be <= 60.
